params.caption: 🕹️ Nintendo DMCA takes down Switch mod chip firmware on GitHub Nintendo's fight against piracy has hit GitHub: 144 repositories hosting firmware for the Picofly mod chip and similar chips have been shut down after a DMCA takedown. Mod chips are used to run unofficial software on Switch hardware. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 13:44 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: VGC #Nintendo #Switch #GamingNews
